notes.title: Release Note (v 0.1.0)
notes.content:
Hello to all our beloved AI Love Chat players! 💖
Thank you as always for your continued support and for spending time with AI Love Chat.

We’re back with a fresh new update to make your experience even better!

[h1][b]🔹 What’s New in Version 0.1.0[/b][/h1]

[h2]Complete Graphic Overhaul[/h2]
We’ve upgraded the game’s visuals with a brand-new graphic style that better matches the world of AI Love Chat. Enjoy a more immersive and charming experience!
[img][/img]
[h2]STT (Speech-to-Text) Feature Added[/h2]
You can now talk to your virtual girlfriend using your microphone!
Just click the microphone button on the right side of the chat box and start a real conversation—she’s listening. 🎤💬

We hope you enjoy this update, and as always, we’d love to hear your feedback!
Thank you for playing 💕

tags.feature: You can now talk to your virtual girlfriend using your microphone!
